newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN LOSE 1-0 AT LOWLY LE HAVRE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARIS ST GERMAIN LOSE 1-0 AT LOWLY LE HAVRE.

text.p: Paris St Germain slumped to a 1-0 defeat at lowly Le Havre in the French soccer league on Friday on a 76th-minute penalty by Teddy Bertin.
The Cup winners' Cup holders remained in second place seven points behind leaders Monaco, who won 3-0 at Rennes on Thursday, helped by a double by Sylvain Legwinski.
Nantes extended their unbeaten run to 22 matches by winning 2-1 at bottom club Nice.
Chadian striker Japhet N'Doram put Nantes in front after three minutes and Frederic Da Rocha made it 2-0 in the 76th minute. James Debbah reduced the deficit with three minutes remaining.
Nantes, recovering from a poor start to the season, move one place up to fifth in the 20-strong table.
